# ⑂ BubbleChat
**分支对话 · Branch Chat for DeepSeek Harness**
在对话里选中一段文字，就地开一个气泡分支追问；分支共享主对话的全部上下文，但问答只出现在气泡里，主对话保持原样。
_Select any passage in a conversation and open a bubble branch to ask follow-ups about it. The branc
h shares the full context of the main conversation, while its Q&A; stays inside the bubble — the mai
n transcript is left untouched._
**中文** · **English**
### 功能一览
| 功能 | 说明 |

| 选区开分支 | 选中文本后浮出工具条，一键创建锚点（记录轮次、字符偏移、出现序号、前后各 20 字指纹） |
| 锚点标签 | 关闭气泡后，原文旁保留 `⑂N` 标签（N 为分支消息数），点击即打

开对应分支 |
| 独立气泡面板 | 可拖动、八向缩放、左侧锚点列表宽度可拖、输入区高度可拖（双击各自恢复默认），位置尺寸自动记忆 |
| 共享主对话记忆 | 分支提问以隐藏标记回到同一会话，模型看到

完整上下文，回答自然承接前文 |
| 主对话零污染 | 插件只维护自己独占的 `<style>` 来隐藏分支轮次，不修改主转录任何节点属性；清空即立刻恢复 |
| 完整渲染还原 | 不是把回答当纯文本

塞进气泡，而是克隆主会话里那份渲染结果，Markdown、公式、代码高亮、表格都保留 |
| 精确定位回原文 | 轮次 + 偏移 + 上下文指纹 + 第 N 次出现多路尝试，最终用 `Range.to

String()` 严格比对，对不上就拒绝跳转而不是「大致跳过去」 |
| 多分支管理 | 左侧列表显示每条分支的引用摘要与消息数，可切换、可删除（删除会连带该分支对话） |
| 本地持久化 | 锚点

、对话、窗口位置与尺寸、隐藏状态都写在 `localStorage`（`dsh-branch-chat/v5`），刷新或重启后仍在 |
| 零依赖、无构建 | 只有一个客户端文件，React 由宿主提

在 `localStorage`（`dsh-branch-chat/v5`），刷新或重启后仍在 |
| 零依赖、无构建 | 只有一个客户端文件，React 由宿主提供；没有构建步骤，不需要打包工具 |
#### 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2 预览版**（桌面端或 Web 客户端）
- 能安装第三方插件（「插件」面板可管理 profile 时即可）
### 已知限制
- **依赖 DSH 客户端的 DOM 约定**（`data-chat-turn`、`data-turn-process-answer`、`data-chat-group-part` 等）。DeepS

eek Harness 大版本升级可能改动这些标记，届时需要适配。
- **只测过 Web 客户端**（`dsh.client.platform = "web"`，桌面端渲染的也是 Web 客户端）。

- **分支问答真实占用会话上下文**：隐藏是显示层的，长对话里开很多分支仍会累积 token。
- **回答捕获依赖主会话空闲**：插件会等主会话本轮结束再抓取；若抓取失败会提示「回答已生成，但未

能捕获（可点『定位』）」，此时该轮分支内容会留在主对话中可见。
- **状态存在浏览器本地**：`localStorage` 按浏览器/设备存储，不跨设备同步；清空站点数据会丢失锚点与分支对话。
-

轮分支内容会留在主对话中可见。

- 暂不支持分支导出、分享或重命名。
### 兼容性
| 项目 | 版本 |

| DeepSeek Harness | 0.2 预览版 |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis`（peer） | `~4.0.4` |
| 平台 | Web 客户端（桌面端 / 浏览器）

|
| 运行时依赖 | 无（React 由宿主提供） |
### What it is
BubbleChat is a client plugin for DeepSeek Harness that turns follow-up questions into an in-place g
hat is a client plugin for DeepSeek Harness that turns follow-up questions into an in-place gesture:

1. Select any passage in a conversation — the assistant's answer or your own message;
2. Click the f
follow-up Q&A; lives inside the bubble, and the main transcript stays untouched.
A branch is not a new session. The question is sent back to the **same conversation** as a quoted, m
arker-tagged message, so the model keeps the complete context. Once the answer finishes, the plugin
clones its rendered output into the bubble and hides the branch turns in the main transcript.
### Why
- **No context re-explaining** — branches reuse the main conversation's memory; nothing needs to be

pasted again.
- **No broken reading flow** — asking directly in the main thread inserts the answer i

n the middle of the transcript. Branches keep Q&A; out of the reading line.
- **Multiple angles on t
he same passage** — “why this design?”, “any counterexample?”, “how would this look in PyTorch?” can

each hang off the same quote independently.
- **Always find the source again** — an anchor badge st
ays next to the quoted text; one click locates it.
### Features
| Feature | Description |
| Branch from selection | Select text, click the floating button; the anchor stores turn, character

offset, occurrence index and 20-character context fingerprints |
| Anchor badge | After closing the

bubble, an inline `⑂N` badge (N = messages in that branch) marks the passage; click to reopen |

[该节后续省略]
#### Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2 preview** (desktop app or web client)
- Ability to install third-party plug
ins (an installable/managed profile)
### Known limitations
- **Depends on DSH client DOM contracts** (`data-chat-turn`, `data-turn-process-answer`, `data-chat-

group-part`, …). Major DSH upgrades may change them and require adaptation.
- **Only the web client

is tested** (`dsh.client.platform = "web"`; the desktop app renders the web client).
- **Branch Q&A;

really consumes context.** Hiding is presentational; many long branches still add tokens.
- **Captu
re depends on the main session going idle.** If capture fails you will see “answer generated but not

captured (use Locate)”, and that branch's turns remain visible in the main transcript.
- **State is
per browser.** `localStorage` is not synced across devices; clearing site data loses anchors and th

reads.
- No branch export/share/rename yet.
### Compatibility
| Item | Version |

| DeepSeek Harness | 0.2 preview |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` (peer) | `~4.0.4` |
| Platform | Web clie

nt (desktop app / browser) |
| Runtime dependencies | none (React from the host) |
